text:
You need a lead list of USA IT startup companies with founder/managing director names and direct business emails.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, data cleaning, and building organized prospect lists in Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, and Power BI. I can research and compile a clean, structured list with the fields you need: first name, last name, company name, company website, title, and email.

In my Marketing attribution analysis project for Verdant Skincare, I built a BigQuery/SQL workflow to compare channel credit and helped reallocate 18% of ad budget. In my Shopify customer segments project for Juniper & Ash Home, I built customer segments in Google Sheets and Looker Studio that made up 9% of customers and 41% of revenue, helping increase email revenue by 19%.

I can deliver accurate, well-formatted lead generation work for your search.
